'''Harian''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor-General]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who was present at the [[Royal Hunting Lodge]] on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] shortly before the [[Battle of the Meridian Complex]].<ref name="TOR" />
